title: Frosty meeting between Latvian government and NGOs
summary_full: A meeting between Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (United List) and non-governmental organisations (NGOs) was not a constructive dialogue, according to representatives of the organisations. The government will continue to criticise NGO funding.
